messages:
Mia (CS): Quick sync — Harbor-Neo finished onboarding tests in EU yesterday and hit a hard rate cap during synthetic load. They want a temporary lift + IP allowlist for ramp to prod. Renewal in ~6 weeks so smooth demo is priority.
Omar (AM): They requested 48h burst to 600 rps in eu-west-1 then revert. CTO says traffic from a few IPs behind their proxy.
Tim (Ops): Check capacity headroom in eu-west-1. If OK, set auto-revoke at T+48h. Recommend soft throttle instead of manual on-call.
Jen (Infra): I can add allowlist + temporary rate window. Need exact CIDRs and whether TLS is terminated client-side or at their proxy. Also confirm if they require region pinning.
Mia (CS): CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.12/32. TLS terminated at proxy.harbor-neo.internal. They prefer eu-west-1 pin for demo latency.
Jen (Infra): Draft policy:

account: harbor-neo (id: 8921)
allowlist: [203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.12/32]
rate_limit_override: region=eu-west-1; burst_rps=600; duration=48h; auto_revoke=true

Need signed ticket + AM approval. Confirm using API keys.
Omar (AM): Confirmed API keys + standard auth. Filing ticket and uploading signed approval from their security lead. Flagging renewal team for follow-up.
Tim (Ops): Once ticket is live I will apply config and add monitoring: tokens/sec, 99p latency, error rate. Suggest runbook checks at t+2h, t+12h, t+36h.
Mia (CS): I'll run enablement call with their platform engineer during change window (tomorrow 09:00 UTC) and collect feedback.
SRE-Bot: Creating ticket T-1758642 with owner Jen (Infra). Auto-revoke scheduled for 1758814801. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Omar (AM): Reacted :thumbsup:. Signed approval uploaded.
Jen (Infra): Will apply allowlist & rate override at scheduled window. ETA 09:05 UTC tomorrow to start. Will report when live and when auto-revoke confirmed.
Tim (Ops): Dashboard will be: harbor-neo / acct-8921 / eu-west-1: tokens/sec, p99 latency, error rate. Alerts: >75% burst for 5m; error rate >1% for 3 checks.
Mia (CS): Next steps: Omar confirm ticket has signed doc, Jen apply during window, Tim monitor, I'll capture feedback and post short post-mortem if unexpected.
Omar (AM): Also looping renewal / marketing for potential case study if ramp successful.
SRE-Bot: Ticket T-1758642 status -> scheduled. Auto-revoke set. End of thread.
